thread:
Ana (PM): Quick note — I sketched a compact governance scorecard for launch gating. Goal: one-page go/no-go signal we can share with execs. Please review and flag blockers by 5pm PT.
Kev (Eng): link?
Ana (PM): https://redwood.internal/docs/launch-governance-scorecard (draft). tl;dr: 5 axes — SLA, Monitoring, Support, Docs, Pricing/Commercial. each axis gets a 0-3 score and a must-fix-if-negative flag.
Maya (SRE): Love the scoring idea. For Monitoring we need synthetics per route + alerts on 95/99 latencies. Current gap: we only have region-level synths for hosted API.
Kev (Eng): noted. I'll add route-level synthetics and push a small exporter for per-model p95/p99 by EOD tomorrow.
Jon (Docs): Docs status: walkthrough + quickstart done. Missing: runbook snippets and escalation matrix. I can draft runbook entries but need owners for oncall steps.
Ana (PM): Oncall owners: Maya + Kev for first 2 weeks, then rotate to platform team. We need explicit 2x rotation coverage during ramp. Add to scorecard as "oncall capacity" check.
Priya (Fin): Pricing readiness: we need clear tier mapping and a gating decision on free-trial credits. Ops impact if we enable broad credits at launch. Recommend gated pilot to a small customer cohort.
Ana (PM): Agreed. Scorecard item: "Billing gating" — must have quota guardrails + alert on unexpected spend.
Maya (SRE): Also add capacity planning check: verify dedicated pool run-rate at 2x expected Q1 peak and burst policy validated. Current simulator shows 1.6x on some models.
Kev (Eng): I'll re-run the load sim with updated batching and quantization knobs. If we can't hit 2x, we document acceptable mitigation (gradual ramp + traffic shaping).
Jon (Docs): Draft runbook snippet for incident runbook posted, incl. commands and quick checks. Paste below for review:
```
# Quick triage
1) Check `redwood/metrics/api_latency_p99` by model
2) Confirm region fallback policy is active: `cfg.routing.fallback=true`
3) If capacity low, toggle `burst_mode=true` on Dedicated pool (owner: Kev)
```
Ana (PM): Nice. That runbook snippet will be a scorecard artifact.
Kev (Eng): small ask — we need a short code sample for SDK retry/backoff to include in docs. I'll drop one in the SDK repo and ping Jon.
Priya (Fin): Commercial gating checklist: 1) Price tiers finalized, 2) Promo credit policy, 3) Billing alerts and quota enforcement. All three must be green.
Maya (SRE): Monitoring checklist detail: synthetic coverage, on-call playbooks, alert noise analysis (false positive rate < 10%), and retention window for traces (90d).
Ana (PM): Okay owners: SLA (Kev), Monitoring & Oncall (Maya), Docs & Runbooks (Jon), Pricing gating (Priya). I'll consolidate scores into the one-pager and post for signoff.
Kev (Eng): Quick clarification on SLA targets: are we locking p95 < 200ms, p99 < 600ms for hosted API?
Ana (PM): Proposed targets: p95 < 200ms, p99 < 700ms, availability >= 99.9% first 90 days. If any SLA axis is red, we need an explicit mitigation and stakeholder signoff.
Maya (SRE): We'll validate those with current telemetry. If p99 is high only for long sequences, we can document a fallback model with softer latency guarantees. Add fallback to scorecard.
Jon (Docs): When you consolidate, include a tiny "what to present to execs" slide: score, key risks, owners, rollout plan. I can make that slide.
Ana (PM): Perfect. Last bit — customer-signal prioritization: mapping of early customers to SLA tiers. We should default most new users to Bronze (best-effort) while pilot customers get Silver/Gallery Gold. Thoughts?
Priya (Fin): Bronze/Silver/Gold mapping OK. But attach contract/commitment criteria for Gold (monthly commit, commercial SLA). Otherwise ops burden is too high.
Kev (Eng): Makes sense. We'll gate Gold activation behind a provisioning checklist (Dedicated or comms signoff).
deploy-bot: deploy 1768456795 completed to staging (:rocket:)
Ana (PM): Thanks team — I'll post the consolidated governance scorecard in this thread by 3pm and request signoffs. If you see any immediate showstoppers call them out now.
Maya (SRE): Blocking item: region-level synthetics only — will be high priority for tomorrow.
Kev (Eng): Noted, taking ownership.
Jon (Docs): I'll finish the runbook snippets and slide by EOD.
Priya (Fin): I'll finalize pricing gating language and post comments in the doc.
Ana (PM): Great — next sync Thursday 10am to review final scores and exec slide. :white_check_mark:
